boundary: Measured-study and author-published raw-data evidence for tool/machine-state monitoring. These records do not change canonical counts until the raw files or contractual data are separately admitted through repository gates.

entries.title: Development of an Open-Source Injection Mold Monitoring System
entries.physicalOutcome: Clear distinguishable normal vs abnormal extraction-force/vibration patterns; fault intervention was physically applied to the ejector/extraction system.
entries.limitation: Fault is deliberately simulated by added friction at one extraction pin; it is not a naturally aged wear history or a population of production mould failures.

entries.title: Analysis of the State and Fault Detection of a Plastic Injection Machine—A Machine Learning-Based Approach
experimentalEvidence: company-expert validation of inferred operational states
entries.physicalOutcome: Operational/anomalous states and functional limits were checked with the industrial data provider; underlying data include failure events but do not identify failure type directly.
entries.dataAccess: Industry-owned; not readily available; authors accessed under maintenance and research contract.
entries.limitation: Cluster-derived state labels are not equivalent to independent shot-level root-cause labels; raw data cannot be used without owner authorization.

entries.title: Towards a general application programming interface (API) for injection molding machines
experimentalEvidence: raw CSV supplements at 2, 33, 50 and 100 Hz
entries.physicalOutcome: Demonstrates synchronization and achievable logging behavior across machine and external sensors rather than a molded-part quality outcome.
entries.limitation: Not a quality-mechanism promotion source by itself; individual supplements must be screened because some tests were performed without the IMM operating.

reviewImpact.remainingNeed: Natural component wear/failure histories with maintenance action and verified post-repair recovery remain scarce.
